name: Gakuen Saiingoku ~Kyouki to Haramase no Utage~
original_name: 学園催淫獄 ～狂気と孕ませの宴～
source:
There's an incident that shocks the entire Japan. The majority of female students at a certain school are pregnant. The culprit has already been captured but nobody knows how he's done it. It's believed that he is a student getting revenge for bullying.

What happened in 9 months after he enters the school? This is the truth of the story.

[Translated from [url=http://www.noirsoft.co.jp/saiingoku/story.html]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
发生了一件震惊整个日本的事件。某学校的大部分女学生都怀孕了。罪魁祸首已经被抓获，但没有人知道他是如何做到的。据信他是一名因欺凌而报仇的学生。

入学9个月后发生了什么？这就是故事的真相。

[翻译自[url=http://www.noirsoft.co.jp/saiingoku/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
